correctness.rationale: Each local coordinate has exactly the displayed polynomial: constant for zero/one successors and ANF degree r-1 at branching r>=2. Coordinatewise affine equivalence is necessary and sufficient. A two-successor matrix has B1=0, proving every iterate identity by induction. Fitting decomposition proves the least uniform preperiod and period, including zero stable image and empty successor rows. The cyclic permutation matrix has minimal polynomial (t+1)^n-1; for odd n the factor t occurs simply, and the invertible factor has degree n-1, so period >=n-1. The smallest size n=3 follows from the order of GL_1(F2). The standalone checker exhausts 15,002 labeled frames (n<=4), 237,068 initial event valuations and ANF degrees 0..6; no finite case is substituted for universal proof.

value.rationale: Non-contingency/knowing-whether is a natural non-normal modal operation. Its exact transition from affine to nonlinear behavior occurs at the maximal local uncertainty of two successors, giving a precise structural boundary rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The Fitting formula classifies the least common preperiod/period for every finite frame in this substantial class; the odd-cycle family demonstrates unbounded periodic behavior even with a uniform two-successor bound, and a three-world frame proves sharp onset. This provides motivated semantic information not supplied simply by a small enumeration or a renaming of an existing example.
